summary: Frontend-only verification of the persistent OT thinking panel (route /?preview=ot). Verified: panel appears on Organizing Thought with Original Assignment (read-only, exact original text) + all 5 stage rows with 'Not started yet'; Original vs 'The Assignment' remain distinct after sharing a representation; prior objects persist across all 5 stages while advancing (Questions→My Ideas→My Current Answer→My Plan); final Continue reads 'Start writing' and lands on the Writing screen. FAILED: Writing-handoff panel is NOT rendered on the Writing screen — the required data-testid=ot-thinking-panel and its rows (ot-panel-original, ot-panel-item-the_assignment, ot-panel-item-my_current_answer, ot-panel-item-my_plan) are absent, and the plain writing layout with the inline 'Your assignment' block is shown instead. Consequently the narrow-screen (480px) check on the writing screen also has no panel to stack. Revisit + draft-preservation and dependency-review flag scenarios were not executed after the handoff bug was found (see action_items).

integration_issues.issue: OTThinkingPanel is not rendered on the Writing screen after 'Start writing'. WritingScreen receives ot={session?.ot} in PublicPreview.jsx (line 333), but session.ot is never populated on the client — otStart/otHandoff return the ot payload separately (stored only in otData), and startPreview/getSession do not embed it into the session object used here. As a result hasOt=false and the plain single-column WritingScreen with data-testid=writing-assignment-display is shown, which is the REGRESSION-mode UI meant for direct /?preview=writing entry. This violates the WRITING HANDOFF CONTEXT requirement and, cascading, the responsive-narrow requirement on the writing screen.

action_items: In PublicPreview.jsx, pass the client-held OT state to WritingScreen instead of the (undefined) session.ot. Minimal fix: change `ot={session?.ot}` on the WritingScreen render to `ot={otData || session?.ot}`. Also propagate the ot returned by otHandoff in OrganizingThought.proceed() up to PublicPreview via onComplete(handoffOt), and store it (setOtData) before switching to writingStarted, so a refresh mid-writing still shows the panel (getSession may need to include ot as well — verify backend response, or hydrate otData from a fresh otStart on resume when handoff_ready).

After the above fix, re-run: (a) writing-handoff context panel content, (b) narrow 480px stacked layout on the writing screen, (c) revisit + draft preservation (data-testid=ot-panel-revisit-the_assignment) and (d) dependency review flag (data-testid=ot-panel-flag-<stage>). These four were not executed to completion in this run because they either follow the handoff or depend on the same panel wiring.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicPreview.jsx line 333: WritingScreen ot prop is sourced from session.ot which is never set client-side; use otData (populated by otStart) or refetch. This is the sole cause of the missing writing-handoff panel.
OrganizingThought.jsx proceed(): otHandoff returns an ot object but the return value is discarded. Propagate it to the parent so the Writing screen has the final ot snapshot without an extra refetch.

PublicPreview.jsx resume path (lines 212-242): on refresh mid-writing (after OT handoff), otData is not rehydrated, so the writing-handoff panel would still be missing even after the primary fix unless the resume path either reads s.ot from the backend or calls otStart again.

success_rate.frontend: ~75% (6/8 scenarios verified; 2 blocked by handoff wiring bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The OT-side panel works correctly on Organizing Thought: original-assignment row is read-only and verbatim; stage rows populate as the student shares; prior objects persist across stage advancement; final button reads 'Start writing'. The break is at the OT→Writing handoff: session.ot is used as the ot source for WritingScreen but is never populated client-side. Fix is a one-liner (`ot={otData || session?.ot}` in PublicPreview.jsx) plus propagating handoff ot upward for refresh resilience. After fix, re-verify writing panel rows, revisit-from-panel with unsaved draft preservation (autosave-on-blur), and needs-review flag (ot-panel-flag-<stage>) after materially editing an earlier stage.
rca of the issue: Root cause: In /app/frontend/src/components/PublicPreview.jsx, WritingScreen is rendered with `ot={session?.ot}`. The session model returned by startPreview/getSession does not include the OT state; the OT state lives in a separate `otData` React state populated by otStart/otAdvance/otHandoff. Because hasOt in WritingScreen is `!!ot`, it evaluates false and the component falls into the single-column layout used for direct writing entry (with data-testid=writing-assignment-display), which is exactly the REGRESSION layout — so the writing-handoff requirement fails. Reproduction: /?preview=ot → begin → paste long assignment → continue → share strong content through all five stages → click 'Start writing'. Expected: writing-input visible AND ot-thinking-panel with original + the_assignment + my_current_answer + my_plan rows. Actual: writing-input visible, panel absent, writing-assignment-display present. Mitigation: pass otData (or otData || session?.ot) to WritingScreen; propagate otHandoff's returned ot upward to setOtData before flipping to writingStarted; ensure resume flow rehydrates otData when the writing screen is resumed after handoff.
